messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your volume commitment of 94,800 kg per year; please provide the historical consumption data to substantiate this figure. Which volume can you commit to? 

As we cannot offer a fixed price over 24 months, we have selected your second package which includes the AS-14404 index. While our material is covered until March 2027, this does not offset all our operational increases; however, we can offer €5.63 per unit for these terms. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. In recognition of this confirmed volume, we are pleased to lower our offer to €5.55 per unit.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.61 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, we can offer a package with a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.55 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to move forward. As a valued partner, we are always eager to support your operations with our extensive inventory and service. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

In response to your proposal of 60 days payment terms, we can offer a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This represents a further concession on our part to help us reach an agreement. 

For your information, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
